name: Speaking
description:
Speaking instructions
You will answer some questions about yourself and then do three short speaking tasks.

Listen to the instructions and speak clearly into your microphone when you hear the signal.

Each part of the test will appear automatically.

The test will take about 12 minutes.



When you click on the next button, the test will begin.

name: Listening
description:
Listening instructions
You will listen to seventeen recordings.

Click on the PLAY button to listen to each recording.

You can listen to each recording TWO TIMES ONLY.

You have 40 minutes to complete the test.



When you click on the next button, the test will begin.

name: Grammar & Vocabulary
description:
Grammar and Vocabulary instructions
The test consists of two sections:

Grammar: 25 questions

Vocabulary: 5 tasks with 5 questions each

Total Time: 25 minutes

name: Numeracy
description:
Numeracy instructions
This practice test has 16 tasks.

After you have completed an item, click on the 'Next' button. You will not be able to go backwards in the test to check your answers, so please make sure you are happy with your response before you click 'Next'.

If a question asks you to type in a result or number, only put in the number. For example, if the answer is 15 metres, type 15. If the answer is $12, only type 12.

In the later stages of the test you will see a calculator image in the top right hand of the screen. Click on it to use the calculator. You can move the calculator around the screen by dragging and dropping it.

The maximum allowed time for this practice test is 25 minutes but you can take the practice test as many times as you want.



When you click on the 'Next' button, the test will begin.
